input.publication: Complete and fsync outside watched input, then same-filesystem no-overwrite hard link. Unsupported filesystem fails closed.
input.fin_semantics: No further appends; permits terminal cleanup. Scanner can process new or changed CSV before .fin exists.
input.identity: Persistent account + command kind + sid/request_id transport claim survives CSV cleanup. Never retry an uncertain publication.
input.acknowledgement: FILE_PUBLISHED is transport evidence only. Terminal order report determines broker state.

output.header_policy: Exact required columns; official long_name(short_name), long_name, or documented short_name accepted. Unknown/missing/duplicate columns rejected.
output.missing_policy: Unavailable; never synthesize zero balances or broker acknowledgement.
output.replay: Re-read bounded complete prefix. Fill identity account+sid+exec_id, record version excludes recv_at. No destructive cursor advancement or business ledger in gateway.
output.over_limit_policy: Blocked until controlled archival/rotation and trade-side replay are implemented and verified.

transport.wire: HTTPS JSON, not a running gRPC server
transport.client_auth: Trusted CA AND explicit SHA256 leaf-certificate allowlist
transport.server_auth: Go client validates configured CA and endpoint hostname; no insecure override
transport.account_scope: One configured account per gateway process

remaining_admission_evidence: Actual terminal version, exports, encoding, enum and market mapping
DGX-to-Windows network, certificate deployment/rotation and host restart
Durable trade-side report ingestion, account ledger/outbox and full replay checkpoint
Terminal login/scanner health and cross-file consistent reconciliation
At least 20 real SIM trading days and separate restricted L2 approval
